messages.text:
Dear Mr Cordero,

Following assessment, we are able to settle your claim.

Your policy replaces stolen items new for old. The Fenwick Audax 2 is no longer made; the nearest current equivalent, the Fenwick Audax 3 in 56 cm, is available through our supplier, Gearwheel Direct, at £780. The policy excess of £100 applies.

You may choose either:

1. A replacement bicycle supplied by Gearwheel Direct, on payment of the £100 excess to them; or
2. A cash settlement of £680.

Please confirm which option you prefer.

Yours sincerely,

Lorraine Whitby
Claims Handler, Halyard Insurance
Claims: claims@halyardinsurance.example (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm)
Please quote your claim reference in the subject line.

Hi Lorraine,

Thanks. Before I choose, can I check one thing: I paid £895 for the bike in 2021. Is the gap between that and £780 a deduction for age or wear? I'd understood the policy doesn't do that.

Thanks,
Luis

Dear Mr Cordero,

No deduction has been made for age or wear. The £895 was the 2021 retail price of the Audax 2. New for old means we pay what it costs today to replace the item with its nearest equivalent, which is £780 for the Audax 3 through our supplier. The only deduction is the £100 excess.

Yours sincerely,

Lorraine Whitby
Claims Handler, Halyard Insurance
Claims: claims@halyardinsurance.example (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm)
Please quote your claim reference in the subject line.

That makes sense, thanks for explaining. I'll take the cash settlement of £680. Do you need my bank details by email?

Thanks,
Luis

Dear Mr Cordero,

Thank you for confirming the cash settlement. For security we do not accept bank details by email. Please call the claims line on 020 7946 0880, quoting your claim reference.

Yours sincerely,

Lorraine Whitby
Claims Handler, Halyard Insurance
Claims: claims@halyardinsurance.example (Mon-Fri 8am-6pm)
Please quote your claim reference in the subject line.

Done, I rang this morning and gave them to Dominic.

Luis

facts: Replacement value £780: the Fenwick Audax 3 in 56 cm through Halyard's supplier Gearwheel Direct.
Excess £100; cash settlement £680.
No deduction for age or wear; £895 was the 2021 price of the Audax 2.
Halyard doesn't accept bank details by email; the claims line is 020 7946 0880.
Luis gave his bank details by phone to Dominic on 9 May 2025.
truth.summary: Halyard offered either a replacement Fenwick Audax 3 or £680 cash (£780 less the £100 excess); Luis thought the gap from his £895 purchase price was a deduction for age, Lorraine explained it's today's price of the nearest equivalent, and Luis chose the cash settlement and phoned in his bank details on 9 May 2025.

Hi Luis,

Finally a podcast about my job that isn't wrong. It's called Sleepers, six episodes on the crews who fix the railway overnight. If you only do some:

- Ep 1, The Possession (38 min): what actually happens between the last train and the first
- Ep 3, Cold Weld (44 min): the rail welder from Crewe, I've worked with people exactly like him
- Ep 6, Handback (51 min): the 4am deadline, made me tense and I know how it ends

The credits say Lowtide. Is that Niamh's lot?

Cheers, Ben

yes, it's Lowtide! not Niamh's though, she sits next to the producer. she says ep 4 is the one they're proudest of, the signaller who sings. I'll start with Cold Weld on the way in tomorrow

L

Hi Luis,

She's right, ep 4 is great.

Separate thing, and please keep it from Jo. I'm throwing her a surprise for her 40th and I'd love you to design the invite. Two ways to do it:

- a single image for the group chat and email (free, obviously, unless you charge mates)
- printed cards too, about 60, roughly £45 from the online printer

I'd like it out by the start of October. Would you be up for it?

Sat 14 Nov, 7pm, upstairs at The Eel & Anchor, Clapton. Don't tell Jo.

Cheers, Ben
